research_mode: official Police.uk sources only; stop-search missing states, crime-outcome histories, spatial request modes and approximate-location semantics; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Force stop-search linked-outcome field
verified_claims: outcome_linked_to_object_of_search can be true or false
the field can also be null when not provided
the field describes whether the outcome related to the object searched for
limitations: null must not be converted to false
the field is not a general measure of stop effectiveness

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Crime-outcome history identifier
verified_claims: the crime-outcome history endpoint uses the crime identifier returned by other methods
the required identifier is 64 characters
the response returns a crime object and associated outcomes
limitations: an API identifier is not a police case number
identifier validity does not prove location precision

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: PSNI outcome-availability boundary
verified_claims: crime outcomes are not available through this method for the Police Service of Northern Ireland
the limitation is explicitly documented
the absence is endpoint coverage rather than a zero outcome
limitations: Northern Ireland coverage must not be inferred from England and Wales endpoints
unavailability is not a public-safety finding

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Optional outcome person identifier
verified_claims: outcome entries can include person_id
the identifier relates to a suspect or offender where available
the field can be absent or null
limitations: person_id must not be treated as a public identity
missing person_id does not mean no person was involved

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Outcome code and display name
verified_claims: an outcome category includes an internal code
it also includes a human-readable name
the two fields serve different machine and display roles
limitations: human labels should not replace stable codes in joins
code presence is not an ordered severity scale

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Outcome date and crime month separation
verified_claims: each outcome can have its own date
the crime object carries a separate crime month
an outcome can therefore occur after the recorded crime month
limitations: outcome date must not overwrite crime month
elapsed time requires explicit month arithmetic and coverage checks

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-outcome spatial query modes
verified_claims: street outcomes can be requested for a specific location identifier
they can be requested around a latitude-longitude point
they can also be requested within a custom polygon
limitations: the three modes have different spatial meanings
results from different modes should not be silently pooled

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Outcome polygon response ceiling
verified_claims: a custom area must contain no more than 10,000 outcomes
requests exceeding that limit return HTTP 503
the ceiling applies to the custom-area outcome method
limitations: HTTP 503 in this context can indicate result size rather than service absence
large areas must be subdivided without double counting

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Custom-polygon closure rule
verified_claims: custom polygons are supplied as colon-separated latitude-longitude pairs
the first and last coordinate need not be identical
the service joins the final point back to the first by a straight line
limitations: implicit closure can create an unintended final edge
polygon validity remains the caller's responsibility

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Nearest predefined crime location
verified_claims: a latitude-longitude request does not use the exact input point as an incident location
the service finds the nearest predefined location
it returns crimes associated with that predefined location
limitations: nearest-location matching is not exact-point matching
the result must not be represented as parcel-specific crime
